thread:
maria: Starting a quick security preflight for the new ap-northeast-3 GPU cluster. Primary focus: IAM bindings, KMS/HSM integration for node sealing, and secrets rotation. Can people ack and list any extra checks?

aj: Ack. I'll validate the IAM roles and service account policies. Quick checklist I run: least-privilege for node SA, no wildcard actions, explicit KMS decrypt/encrypt only where needed.

sasha: Also check node identity provisioning (SPIFFE/SDS) and that kubelet doesn't have broad secrets access. We've had a misconfig where nodes could read all k8s secrets.

maria: Good call. For KMS/HSM - we need a dedicated key per-tenant group and a rotation policy. Is HSM attestation required for this region? @lena (sec)

lena (sec): For ap-northeast-3 we require HSM-backed keys if customer data classification >= sensitive. Otherwise software KMS with CMK + envelope encryption is acceptable. Also require key aliasing convention: redwood/apn3/<cluster-id>/<purpose>.

aj: Posting the minimal IAM snippet I use for node agent (remove sensitive values):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/REDACTED"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["secretsmanager:GetSecretValue"],"Resource":"arn:aws:secretsmanager:region:acct:secret:redwood/apn3/*"}
  ]
}
```

sasha: Don't forget to limit `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue` with condition on `iam:PassedToService` or resource tags so pods can't escalate.

infra-bot: preflight-run 1958123460 started for cluster apn3-gpu-02.

infra-bot: preflight-run 1958123540 result: WARNING - node role has wildcard S3 access (s3:*). See iam-binding: node-role.

maria: Ugh, that wildcard slipped in from terraform module. Assigning to @aj to fix the role mapping and create a least-privilege policy.

aj: On it. I'll patch the tf and run `terraform plan` then `apply` in the sandbox. Quick test commands: `aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn arn:... --action-names s3:ListBucket s3:GetObject` to validate.

lena (sec): Also validate audit logs for KMS usage are enabled and sent to secure-log-bucket with encryption. We need CloudTrail + KMS key policy that denies `kms:GenerateDataKey*` unless requestor is in the node-role principal list.

maria: For secrets rotation - plan is: create rotation schedule in secrets manager for node bootstrap tokens and ensure bootstrap tokens are short-lived (1h). Document the manual rotate steps if automation fails.

sasha: Add an emergency fallback: a sealed-secret file in keystore with restricted read only by oncall, with a 4-eyes approval recorded in ticket.

aj: Pushed IAM fix to branch `apn3/iam-tighten-1958`. Running CI tests now.

devsecops-bot: CI job `iam-lint` passed. `policy-check` failed: found `kms:CreateGrant` allowed on CMK.

lena (sec): We should avoid `CreateGrant` for anything except the key admin service. Grants can allow unexpected delegation. Only allow `CreateGrant` to a small admin role with MFA enforced.

maria: Good. After aj's fix and removing createGrant for node-role, can someone run the end-to-end bootstrap in the staging account? I want logs for: node boot, kv-seal, secrets fetch, workload startup.

sasha: I'll run it and post the smoke logs. Expecting it later today.

infra-bot: e2e-bootstrap 1958126700 started in staging account apn3-stg.

infra-bot: e2e-bootstrap 1958126777 completed: OK except transient 504 from secretsmanager during first fetch; retries succeeded.

maria: Thanks. Action items: 1) @aj remove s3 wildcard & CreateGrant for node-role (in branch), 2) @sasha run e2e in prod-sim and upload logs, 3) @lena produce final key policy template and alias naming. I'll circle back for handoff doc once CI green. :thumbsup:

aj: Done for CreateGrant in branch, re-running policy-check.

devsecops-bot: policy-check passed on branch apn3/iam-tighten-1958.

maria: Great — I'll create the handoff ticket and include these snippets and the log links. If anyone sees missing checks we should add them now.

sasha: One more: validate node eviction on network partition doesn't leak keys into disk cache. We'll run a forced partition test.

maria: Add that to the handoff checklist. Thanks all.
